description: Set when one dashboard panel sends alert email and/or a webhook (colour change, threshold cross, or off). trigger: change (default), red, notgreen, above, below, or off; above/below need limit. notify: both, email, or webhook. panel is the 0-based index in the live spec. Saving can send immediately if a limit was just crossed (unless this panel alerted within the last hour). Later sends happen after scheduled fetches. Default change+both removes a custom rule. Does not change colour lines or save a dashboard version.

trigger.description: change, red, notgreen, above, below or off

name: set_panel_alert
title: Configure panel alerts
